identification: Four Tasmanian/Australian art pottery vases: John Campbell (Launceston) brown drip baluster, base glaze wear; H McHugh Tasmania 42 brown drip vase with rim chip; unsigned blue drip waisted vase; Remued 28 (Premier Pottery, Preston) blue and cream drip vase with rim chip. Plus Usher's whisky tray, pub tray, decanter in box, bisque figure group, green vase, china. Photos read: signatures confirmed on bases.

entries.note: McHugh two vases, blue and brown, 12cm and 9.5cm, signed. Realised price from local database, premium status unstated; database entry only, page not opened. Similar small size to our McHugh.
McHugh vase 22.5cm, unusual glaze, signed. Larger and better glaze than ours; upper bound for a good McHugh. Database entry only.
John Campbell blue two-handled vase 18cm. Different shape and glaze from our brown baluster. Database entry only.
John Campbell green glaze vase with brown highlights, 25cm. Our baluster looks around this size, brown drip glaze, with base wear. Database entry only.
John Campbell small mottled vase 14.5cm; low end of Campbell. Database entry only.
Campbell two-handled bulbous art pottery vase; hammer, premium extra. Database entry, page not opened.
Remued small gumnut vase blue and lime, 8cm. Our Remued is a plain blue drip vase (Premier Pottery style) with a rim chip, so likely worth less. Database entry only.
Remued blue and green vase 10cm with foil label. Gumnut-decorated pieces fetch more than plain drip glaze. Database entry only.
McHugh Tasmania signed vase, Gowans hammer. Local room, not resale.
John Campbell pottery vase signed, Gowans hammer. Local room, not resale.
Mixed pottery lot with chipped Remued vase, Gowans hammer. Local room, not resale.
